title: index.embedding.requested payload (v2, closed)
description: Payload of index.embedding.requested. Producer: app/outbox/events.py::emit_index_embedding_requested (payload = {object_id}; other fields ride in meta). Consumer: app/indexer/consumer.py::_extract_object_id requires object_id. Closed contract (#5704): undeclared top-level fields are rejected; producer extras belong under `extensions`. v1 stays registered for rows already tagged `index.embedding.requested.v1`.

event_id.description: Envelope event id the worker run() loop copies into the payload before dispatch; carried onto retries.

_worker_retry_enqueued_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the worker retry enqueue.

extensions.description: The only open extension point: producer-specific extras must be nested here, never added as undeclared top-level fields.
